our.definition:
pl.  of I
possessive pron. Of or pertaining to us; belonging to us; as, our
   country; our rights; our troops; our endeavors. See I.

our family went camping last summer.translation: 去年夏天我们全家去露营
our family went camping last summer.word: Our family went camping last summer

our father.translation: n. 天父（源自《圣经》马太福音）

our lady's mild thistle.translation: [网络] 我们的夫人的乳蓟

our population has increased.translation: 我们的人口已经增加了

ouranopithecus.translation: [网络] 欧兰猿属；乌朗诺古猿

ouranos.translation: [网络] 乌拉诺斯；天神乌拉诺斯；天空乌拉诺斯

ourari.translation: n. [植]箭毒马鞍子,箭毒(箭毒马鞍子的毒素,南美印地安人用以浸制毒箭)

ours.definition:
pl.  of I
possessive pron. See Note under Our.

ourselves.definition:
pl.  of Myself
pron. ; sing. Ourself (/). An emphasized form of the
   pronoun of the first person plural; -- used as a subject, usually with
   we; also, alone in the predicate, in the nominative or the objective
   case.
